summary: Contemplation Engine v2.1: signal-driven Q&A with evidence evaluation and strict closure
description: Replaces v1 heuristics with real answer_signal parsing (checklist/artifact/keyword formats per #326), evidence-based signal evaluation with citations, strict close decision (only if signal met with confidence + usage report), typed child issue creation (Feature/Research/Design with back-refs), and enhanced blocking Question resumption with detailed unblock reports.

tests/test_contemplation.py:1-433 (20 comprehensive tests covering signal parsing, evaluation, closure, child creation, blocking resumption, integration flows)
src/plate_core/mcp_server.py:194-201 (plate_contemplate tool updated for v2.1 with all_previous_answers support)
src/plate_core/agent_guidance.py:73-141 (QANDA_CURIOSITY_GUIDANCE updated with v2.1 specifics section)

verification_evidence: All 335 tests pass including 20 new contemplation-specific tests
Test coverage: signal parsing (5 tests), evaluation logic (6 tests), full engine (6 tests), integration (1 test), trigger function (1 test), usage report (1 test)
Supports checklist format (- [ ] item), artifact requirements (docs/, commit, .md), keyword matching
Evidence-based evaluation with citations, confidence scoring (high/medium/low)
Strict closure: only when signal met with medium-to-high confidence, includes === USAGE REPORT ===
Child creation: types issues (Feature/Research/Design) based on content, includes parent refs
Blocking resumption: detects PLATE-BLOCKING-DUMP, posts unblock report on original with eval status + children
migration_guidance: Existing v1 contemplation calls work unchanged. v2.1 adds optional all_previous_answers parameter to plate_contemplate MCP tool. Question bodies should include answer_signal field (per .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/question.yml) for best results; engine gracefully handles missing signals. Agents should update to v2.1 guidance in agent_guidance.py and plate.agent.md.
